description_expanded: ABOUT MAGNOLIA TIDES Welcome to Magnolia Tides - your upscale coastal escape in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach, Florida. Nestled on the beachside of 30A, this elegant 6-bedroom, 5 full/2 half-bathroom private home sleeps up to 14 guests and offers an unbeatable combination of luxury, comfort, and walkable beach access. Just a 5-minute stroll to the sugar-white sands of the Emerald Coast, Magnolia Tides invites you to relax in style. Unwind in the private pool, sip cocktails by the outdoor fire pit, or gather in one of the many indoor and outdoor living spaces designed with thoughtful details and coastal charm. A full wet bar, fully equipped kitchen, elevator, and fenced yard provide everything you need for a carefree stay. Each of the six king bedrooms features its own ensuite bathroom, spread across the second and third floors - perfect for large families or groups seeking both privacy and connection. Smart TVs, WiFi, and luxury furnishings throughout the home create a space that's as beautiful as it is functional. Whether you're soaking up the sun poolside, enjoying evening breezes from the walkout balconies, or exploring 30A's nearby attractions on your complimentary bikes, Magnolia Tides is your serene sanctuary by the sea. ABOUT THE AREA Magnolia Tides is perfectly positioned in one of 30A's most desirable locations - just south of Scenic Highway 30A on South Gulf Drive. Known for its laid-back luxury and small-town charm, Santa Rosa Beach offers easy access to world-class dining, boutique shopping, and endless outdoor activities. With the beach only a short walk away, and local hot spots like Gulf Place, Blue Mountain Beach, and Seaside just minutes from your door, you'll experience the very best of Florida's Gulf Coast. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * 5-Minute Walk to the Beach * 6 King Ensuite Bedrooms * Private Pool & Fenced Yard * Walkout Balconies with Pool Views * Elevator * Full Wet Bar & Fully Equipped Kitchen * Indoor Fireplace * Outdoor Fire Pit * Smart TVs & WiFi * Dog-Friendly $250 per dog up to 2 * 6 Complimentary Bikes * Multiple Indoor & Outdoor Living Spaces * Luxury Furnishings & Decor PARKING: * 5 Designated Parking Spots * Private Garage PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hours of booking or subject to cancellation * Must be 25 years or older to book * Dog-friendly with approval $250 per dog up to 2 * Smoking not permitted * All reservations are non-refundable - we strongly encourage purchasing travel insurance to protect your trip * Optional Pool Heat: Sept-April at $90 per day DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first-class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained to the highest standard. Our team is local and available 24/7 to ensure your stay is seamless and stress-free. Our mission is to help you create lasting memories, one beach vacation at a time.
